newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SPURS WANT 1860 MUNICH'S NOWAK SAYS KICKER MAGAZINE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPURS WANT 1860 MUNICH'S NOWAK SAYS KICKER MAGAZINE.

text.p: English premier league club Tottenham Hotspur are interested in signing Polish playmaker Peter Nowak from 1860 Munich, the German sports magazine Kicker reported on Monday.
The magazine said Nowak had agreed personal terms with the London club and hoped he could move on a free transfer.
However, 1860 president Karl-Hainz Wildmoser has said the club wants $2 million for the player, whose contract runs until 1999.
"If Tottenham want to come and haggle, the matter is finished straight away. In that case, we'll insist on the (current) contract," Kicker quoted Wildmoser as saying.
No one was available at Tottenham on Monday morning to comment on the report.
